[User]
cyclothymia
Triggers: sleep disruption, uncertainty.
Helps: consistent sleep schedule, mood tracking, limiting alcohol.
Support: Rohan (friend).

[Recent sessions]
[Apr 25] Sleep 4 hrs, mood 5/10. Okay but slightly off.
[May 1] Sleep 4 hrs (improved), mood 3/10 (worse). Confusing pattern — sleep better but mood worse. Mentioned feeling confused about what helps.
i feel like i can't figure out the pattern
Given how your sleep stayed low but your mood dipped further, it makes sense you're feeling stuck — that shift can be really confusing.
I slept better this week, but I just feel more drained and irritable. It’s like my body’s not listening to me.
That disconnect between sleep and how you’re feeling can be so frustrating — like you're doing the right thing but still not landing where you want to be.
I don’t know if I should keep pushing for more sleep or just focus on calming down instead.
It’s okay to pause and ask what your body needs right now — sometimes rest isn’t about more sleep, but gentler rhythm.
